papers.evidence: 面向长上下文Transformer的定长循环KV记忆
papers.tldr: 循环Transformer常受限于固定内存或难以并行训练。Maglev提出双模型架构：预填充器Q用全注意力生成内存目标，解码器P用滑窗注意力与循环K/V注入生成内存，训练时以一致性损失对齐二者，推理仅需P。实验表明其验证损失与下游基准优于滑窗注意力和潜在循环基线，且参数共享可节省内存。该方法兼顾训练并行性与状态记忆，为高效序列建模提供了新方案。
papers.abstract_en: We introduce \ours{}, a recurrent Transformer architecture with fixed-size memory that generalizes sliding-window attention while remaining parallelizable during training. \ours{} consists of two coupled models: a prefiller $Q$, which leverages full attention\footnote{In practice, we use interleaved full and sliding-window attention for $Q$, as this yields stronger performance. The essential requirement is that $Q$ be more expressive than $P$, with access to the full history.} to produce memory targets $m'_t$, and a decoder $P$, which uses only sliding-window attention and recurrent K/V injection to produce decoder memories $m_t$ for next-token prediction. We train \ours{} with a memory consistency loss that aligns $m_t$ with $m'_t$, allowing inference to use $P$ alone. Empirically, \ours{} improves validation loss and downstream pretraining benchmarks over sliding-window and latent recurrent transformer baselines. Moreover, sharing parameters between $P$ and $Q$ reduces parameter memory while preserving most of the gains.

papers.evidence: 固定大小循环记忆减少长上下文推理的KV cache内存
papers.tldr: 针对滑动窗口注意力只能访问局部信息、潜在循环Transformer表达能力有限的问题，Maglev提出双模型架构：预填充器Q使用全注意力产生记忆目标，解码器P仅用滑动窗口和循环KV注入生成记忆，并通过一致性损失对齐两者，使推理仅需P。实验表明，其验证损失和下游基准优于现有基线，参数共享还能降低内存占用。
